title: Best Microsoft Teams Help Desk Apps
summary: Discover the best Microsoft Teams help desk apps for managing support tickets, employee requests, and internal workflows.
body_markdown:
Over[320 million people](https://www.businessofapps.com/data/microsoft-teams-statistics/?ref=unthread.io) use Microsoft Teams daily. When internal support requests still require employees to switch to separate ticketing portals, response times suffer and frustration grows. The best Microsoft Teams help desk apps convert conversations into trackable tickets without forcing anyone to leave the platform where work already happens.


Microsoft Teams has evolved from a simple chat application into a complete workspace hub. For[IT service desks](https://unthread.io/solutions/it-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) and internal support teams, this creates an opportunity to meet employees where they already collaborate. The right help desk app turns Teams conversations into structured tickets with SLA tracking, automated routing, and AI-powered resolution.


## **Key Takeaways**


- Microsoft Teams help desk apps eliminate context-switching by letting employees submit requests and agents resolve tickets without leaving the platform.
- Top options include Unthread for multi-channel internal support, Desk365 for Teams-native simplicity, and Tikit for deep Microsoft 365 ecosystem integration.
- Purpose-built AI agents can automatically resolve[approximately 40%](https://unthread.io/blog/microsoft-teams-ticketing-tools-it-teams) of incoming internal support tickets across IT, HR, and operations teams.
- Key evaluation criteria include Teams integration depth, AI automation capabilities, SLA management, multi-channel support, and ease of admin configuration.
- Effective Teams help desk solutions reduce friction for employees while providing structured workflows for support teams to track SLAs and manage workloads.


## **Understanding the Need for a Microsoft Teams Help Desk App**


Internal support teams face a fundamental challenge: employees expect immediate responses through their primary communication tool, but IT, HR, and operations teams need structured ticketing to track SLAs, manage workloads, and prevent requests from falling through the cracks.


### **Why Teams is Ideal for Internal Support**


Microsoft Teams provides a single location where employees already spend their workday. Rather than requiring staff to navigate to separate portals or send emails that get lost in crowded inboxes, Teams-based help desks capture requests naturally within existing workflows.


**Key benefits of Teams-based internal support include:**


- Reduced friction for employees submitting requests
- Faster response times due to real-time messaging
- Better visibility for managers tracking team workloads
- Centralized communication history for audit and compliance


The platform's native bot framework allows help desk applications to interact conversationally with users. This creates a support experience that feels natural rather than transactional.


### **Key Challenges in Support Management**


Without proper tooling, Teams channels become chaotic. Messages get buried, urgent requests mix with casual conversations, and agents lack visibility into what needs attention. Help desk apps solve these problems by converting messages into tickets with status tracking, priority levels, and assignment routing.


Organizations managing[employee support](https://unthread.io/solutions/employee-support?ref=unthread.io) across multiple departments benefit from structured intake. A dedicated help channel like #it-help can serve as the single entry point for all technology requests, with[workflow automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) routing tickets to the right teams.


## **1. Unthread: Best For Multi-Channel Internal Support Teams Using Both Teams and Slack**


**Price:** Starting at $50/agent/month (Basic), $75/agent/month (Pro); 5-seat minimum


Unthread stands out as the best AI-native internal help desk for teams managing employee support across multiple communication platforms. While most Teams help desk apps require you to choose a single channel, Unthread supports[Microsoft Teams, Slack, and email](https://unthread.io/blog/microsoft-teams-ticketing-tools-it-teams) in a unified inbox.


The platform's purpose-built AI agent resolves[approximately 40% of incoming tickets](https://unthread.io/blog/microsoft-teams-ticketing-tools-it-teams) across IT, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Finance teams. Unlike competitors that achieve high deflection rates mainly by automating access requests, Unthread supports a broader range of internal support use cases.


### **Key features:**


- Multi-channel intake from Teams, Slack, email, and customer portals
- [Agentic AI](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) with intent recognition and knowledge base integration
- [Self-learning documentation](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) that generates articles from resolved tickets
- Natural language automation builder requiring no code
- SLA tracking with escalation paths and on-call rotation


Unthread's admin interface is easier to configure initially and simpler to adjust as workflows, routing rules, and automations evolve. This reduces the overhead that internal support teams typically face when maintaining help desk configurations.


## **2. Desk365**


Desk365 installs directly from the Microsoft App Store in minutes. The platform uses a dual-bot architecture with separate bots for end users and IT technicians.


### **Key features:**


- Support Bot for ticket submission and Agent Bot for technician workflows
- Microsoft Entra ID SSO integration
- Asset management included in Premium tier
- Free tier for small teams with unlimited tickets


The platform provides a straightforward ticketing solution for organizations committed exclusively to Microsoft Teams.


## **3. Tikit by Cireson**


Tikit offers deep native integration with Microsoft 365 admin tools including Intune, Power BI, and Power Automate. The company has built Microsoft ITSM tools since 2011, bringing enterprise maturity to the Teams ticketing space.


### **Key features:**


- Right-click message-to-ticket conversion
- Azure OpenAI-powered Virtual Agent for ticket deflection
- Power Automate integration for complex workflows
- Multi-department ESM support beyond IT


Organizations invested in Microsoft's Power Platform can leverage these integrations for advanced automation workflows.


## **4. TeamsWork (Ticketing as a Service)**


TeamsWork is a Microsoft 365 Certified ticketing solution, meeting SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR compliance standards verified by Microsoft.


### **Key features:**


- Multiple simultaneous ticketing instances for different departments or clients
- Operates entirely within Teams channels with no external portal required
- Usage-based pricing eliminates per-agent cost scaling
- Full certification for security-conscious environments


MSPs managing multiple client environments can benefit from TeamsWork's multi-instance architecture. One application supports separate ticketing systems for distinct organizations.


## **5. HappyFox**


HappyFox provides strong omnichannel capabilities among Teams-integrated tools. The platform unifies support from email, chat, social media, and Teams in a single inbox.


### **Key features:**


- Smart rules automation for assignment and escalation
- Knowledge base with Teams bot integration
- Teams Meeting integration for scheduling directly from tickets
- CSAT collection and reporting


Organizations managing external customer support alongside internal IT can consolidate multiple channels through HappyFox.


## **6. InvGate Service Management**


InvGate deploys a Virtual Service Agent directly inside Teams, converting conversations into trackable tickets with no portal login required.


### **Key features:**


- AI-powered chatbot with knowledge base integration
- ITIL-aligned workflows for incident and change management
- Approval workflows handled directly in Teams
- 30-day free trial for evaluation


InvGate offers ITIL compliance without the configuration overhead of larger enterprise platforms.


## **Integrating AI and Automation for Smarter Help Desks in Teams**


AI capabilities have become the primary differentiator among Teams help desk applications. Basic chatbots answer FAQs, but purpose-built AI agents handle complex routing, draft responses from documentation, and resolve tickets without human intervention.


### **AI's Role in Ticket Resolution**


Modern AI help desk agents go beyond keyword matching. They understand intent, reference knowledge base articles, and take action based on request context.[Unthread's agentic AI](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai?ref=unthread.io) can trigger workflows, escalate tickets, and update external tools automatically.


Organizations achieve the highest deflection rates when AI spans multiple support workflows. Some vendors emphasize high deflection by mainly automating access requests like password resets. Effective AI help desks automate a broader range of scenarios across IT, HR, finance, and operations.


### **Building No-Code Automations**


[Workflow automation](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) separates basic ticketing from true service management. Look for platforms offering:


- Natural language automation creation
- Visual drag-and-drop workflow builders
- Trigger options including messages, emoji reactions, and schedules
- Integration with external tools via API and webhooks


Unthread supports all three creation methods, letting teams choose the approach that matches their technical comfort level.


## **Unified Communications: Managing Tickets Across Microsoft Teams and Email**


Many internal support teams receive requests through multiple channels. Employees might email IT for formal requests while using Teams for quick questions. Without unified intake, agents work across disconnected systems.


### **Bringing Email into Teams Workflows**


[Shared email inbox](https://unthread.io/products/shared-email-inbox?ref=unthread.io) features forward support emails into designated channels, creating private discussion threads for each message. Agents collaborate internally using tags and priorities, then send responses that appear as normal email replies to employees.


This approach consolidates intake without forcing behavioral change. Employees who prefer email continue using email while agents manage everything in Teams.


### **The Power of a Unified Inbox**


Organizations using both Microsoft Teams and Slack face additional complexity. Unthread addresses this by[supporting multi-channel intake](https://unthread.io/blog/microsoft-teams-ticketing-tools-it-teams) from both platforms in a single workflow. Teams using Slack for certain departments and Teams for others can standardize on one help desk system.


## **Key Features to Look for in a Microsoft Teams Help Desk App**


When evaluating options, prioritize features that match your team's specific requirements.


**Essential functionality for any team:**


- SLA tracking with business hours awareness and breach alerts
- Automated ticket routing based on content, category, or requestor
- Assignment management with workload visibility
- Reporting dashboards for volume, resolution time, and agent performance


**Advanced capabilities for scaling teams:**


- [AI-powered analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics?ref=unthread.io) with trend detection and gap analysis
- Multi-team organization support with separate settings per department
- On-call rotation management with automatic escalation
- CSAT and NPS survey collection


**Integration ecosystem requirements:**


- Connections to task management tools (Asana, ClickUp, Linear, Jira)
- CRM integration for customer context (Salesforce, HubSpot)
- HRIS integration for employee data and access provisioning
- API access for custom workflow development


## **Security and Compliance for Help Desk Apps in Microsoft Teams**


Enterprise help desk deployments require robust security certifications and compliance capabilities.


**Standard security requirements:**


- SOC 2 Type II compliance with independent audits
- SSO integration for centralized access control
- SCIM sync for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning
- Encryption for data at rest and in transit


**Industry-specific compliance:**


- HIPAA compliance with Business Associate Agreements for healthcare
- GDPR compliance for organizations with EU employees
- Microsoft 365 Certification for Microsoft-verified security standards


Unthread maintains[SOC 2 Type II](https://unthread.io/security?ref=unthread.io) compliance and offers HIPAA compliance with BAAs on Enterprise plans. The platform supports SSO and SCIM sync for enterprise identity management.


TeamsWork's Microsoft 365 Certification provides additional assurance for organizations prioritizing Microsoft ecosystem compliance.

Selection depends on your organization's specific context.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What is the primary benefit of using a help desk app within Microsoft Teams?**


The primary benefit is eliminating context-switching. Employees submit requests without leaving their primary work tool, and agents manage tickets in the same interface. This reduces friction, speeds response times, and ensures requests get tracked rather than lost in channel noise.


### **Can Microsoft Teams help desk apps integrate with existing ticketing systems like Zendesk or Jira?**


Yes, most enterprise-grade Teams help desk apps offer bidirectional sync with external ticketing platforms. This allows organizations to maintain existing workflows while adding Teams as an intake channel. Unthread integrates with[20+ enterprise tools](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io) including Jira, Zendesk, Salesforce, and ServiceNow.


### **How does AI improve help desk efficiency in Microsoft Teams?**


Purpose-built AI agents deflect tickets by answering questions from knowledge bases, routing requests to appropriate teams based on content analysis, and automating repetitive workflows. Advanced platforms achieve 30-40% automatic resolution rates, freeing agents to focus on complex issues.


### **Are these Microsoft Teams help desk solutions suitable for both small businesses and large enterprises?**


Yes, options exist across the spectrum. Some platforms offer free tiers for small teams, while others like Unthread and InvGate scale to enterprise deployments with advanced security features, custom integrations, and dedicated support.


### **Can I use a Microsoft Teams help desk app for both internal IT and HR support?**


Yes, many platforms support multi-department configurations.[HR service desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/hr-service-desk?ref=unthread.io) use cases often require private ticketing for sensitive requests like payroll, parental leave, and benefits questions. Unthread supports private ticket flows that keep HR request handling confidential while maintaining structured ticketing.
